name: Process Algebra Minimal Expression Set Registry
purpose: Define the minimal approved symbolic expression forms for the Process Algebra phase.

approved_expression_forms.name: core_continuation_closure
approved_expression_forms.allowed_reading: Distinction-generation, continuation-pressure, and residue-binding are simultaneous aspects of one indivisible closure relation.
approved_expression_forms.forbidden_reading: A physical master equation or completed proof of reality.

approved_expression_forms.name: recursive_polarity_relation
approved_expression_forms.allowed_reading: Symbolic exclusion-pole and continuation-pole relation treated as indivisible recursive polarity.

approved_expression_forms.name: candidate_recursive_process_unit
approved_expression_forms.allowed_reading: A candidate symbolic process unit representing recursive polarity.
approved_expression_forms.forbidden_reading: A proven primitive entity or physical particle.

approved_expression_forms.name: projection_limited_domain_coupling
approved_expression_forms.allowed_reading: A restricted projection analogy between distinction-like and continuation-like domains.
approved_expression_forms.forbidden_reading: A claim that quantum mechanics and general relativity are mathematically unified.

restricted_expression_forms.condition: Allowed only if source_relation, aspect roles, non_separability_acknowledged, and claim_level are declared.
Allowed only as projection notation with loss accounting and traceability.
Allowed only as candidate exclusion-admissibility notation, not ordinary negation.

banned_expression_forms.reason: Confuses process notation with physical energy.
